model: SKVF evaporative cooler / humidifier (Modbus communication module)
equipment_type: Air handler evaporative cooler (adiabatic cooling / humidification)
applies_to: Neptronic SKVF series evaporative coolers with the Modbus communication module, guide SKVF-Modbus Guide-211025.
summary: The Neptronic SKVF is an evaporative cooler that can run humidification or cooling control profiles. Its Modbus RTU module exposes holding registers only: signal voltages, room and supply RH and temperature readings, demand and output, humidity and cooling set points with PID terms, water supply, drain and drying settings, inputs and relays as 0/1 registers, and state, alarm, request and control-profile codes.

addressing.note: The guide prints a protocol-base (0-based) address and a six-digit holding register (base 400001) side by side, e.g. 6005 / 406006. The protocol-base number is the wire address.

source.title: SKVF Evaporative Cooler - Modbus Communication Module User Guide

notes: Only function codes 03, 06 and 16 are supported, so binary points (inputs, relays, flags) are 16-bit holding registers holding 0 or 1.
'Scale N' with 'Value x N' means the raw value is the engineering value times N; this map stores the multiplier 1/N.
Temperature and capacity units follow Modbus Server Units (415001): 0 metric, 1 imperial.
The guide text calls automatic baud detection the default, while register 1 lists 19200 as its default value; the baud default is left blank here.
Default unit address is not stated; it is set from the device menu or register 0.

Left out: product name ASCII registers 3-6; 2001 (a second 'Control Signal' row) and 15003/15004 (two rows both named 'Control Signal Type'), where it is unclear which is which; ECM Fan Signal 4001, RH and temperature Supply High Limit Proportional Band 6101/6111 (scale and example disagree); the temperature-control block 6004-6007 (names repeat Control Input/Min/Max/Bias and the example is in %); Room RH Bias 6011 and Room Temperature Network Reading 6082 (typed unsigned with negative ranges); Alarm LED / Power LED 11005/11006 (holding numbers 411004/411005 clash with the protocol column).

Several values are printed as two- or four-register entries marked (0)...(3) - Demand, run/on/service time counters, Room Temperature Setpoint, Room RH and Room Temperature Demand Proportional Band/Gain, Water Supply Duty Cycle/Period, Water Treatment Service Interval, Keep Alive, Demand Low Dead Band and Network Timeout. No word order is given, so they are left out.
System Power State (15000) is printed read-only in this guide.

integration.summary: Read Room RH (6008), Room Temperature (6012), Power Output (6028), State (15009) and System Alarm (15010). For BAS control choose a network Control Profile (15016) and Control Demand Source (15027 = Network) and write Control Network Demand (6112).
integration.enable: Fit the Modbus communication module, set the address in the device menu (or register 0) and choose the control profile (15016) and sources (15019-15028) if the BAS supplies readings or demand.
integration.watchdog: A Network Timeout exists but it is printed as a two-register value without word order (6117-6118), so it is not listed; Network Control State (12000) flags a network fault.
quirks: All points, binary ones included, are holding registers (FC03/06/16 only).
Default framing is no parity with 2 stop bits.
setup: RS-485 two-wire, RTU; 9600-57600 baud or auto baud detection.
Parity/stop bits via register 2 or the Modbus Comport Config menu item.
gotchas: Control Profile chooses humidification (Hum) or cooling (Cool) logic; network profiles need the matching network registers written.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
